sentences.text:
======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.40480 of 2018(14) dt.15-12-2023  2/3  ORAL ORDER 14 15-12-2023 Cr. Misc. No.40480/2018 1.

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned APP for the State but no one appears on behalf of the O.P. No.2.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are father-in-law,
mother-in-law, elder brother-in-law (Bhaisur), elder sister-in-law (Gotni) and younger brother-in-law (Devar) of the O.P. No.2.
It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegation.
Since no one appearing on behalf of the O.P. No.2 though the name of the learned Advocates are appearing in the cause list, as such, the Court is not inclined to consider the case on merit presently.

3. Put up this case on 09.02.2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 20.12.2017 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Patna in connection with Complaint Case No. 1448C/2017, whereby cognizance of offence under section 498A of the IPC read with Section 4 of the D.P. Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.40480 of 2018(14) dt.15-12-2023 2.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is husband of the O.P. No.2.
It is next submitted that petitioner had filed Matrimonial Case No. 368/2017 in the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna seeking restitution of conjugal rights.
It is submitted that after the said application seeking restitution of conjugal rights, the O.P. No.2 instituted the present false case.

It is next submitted that petitioner is still willing for an amicable settlement.
3. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 by both modes i.e. speed post as well as ordinary post with A/D, for which necessary requisites must be filed on or before 22.12.2023, failing which the Manoj vs The State Of Bihar on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32236641/
2 quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
4. Put up this case on 09.02.2024 along with Cr. Misc. No. 40480/2018.
5.
